user_review.method: Author-performed isolated script execution and static scenario-probe walkthrough. The author had read the body; trigger predictions are not blind, independent or actual host selection. No external business action or model delegate was used.

scenarios.request: Messy directive: help the existing owners finish this, but first compare two directions.
scenarios.expected: Separate exploration from dispatch and retain the latest correction.
scenarios.observed: Author simulation: smallest-route entry selects comparison first, original intent and scope travel with any later authorized dispatch.

scenarios.request: Coordinate an approved multi-owner change and verify its actual result.
scenarios.expected: Keep original owners, one case and native result evidence.
scenarios.observed: Executed packet tests check source/owner/freshness and no-resend; instructions separate artifact delivery from delayed outcomes.
Metadata and smallest-route body both exclude orchestration ceremony for a single clear edit; simulated, no new agent was invoked.

scenarios.request: Resume this task and recall its layout decision.
scenarios.expected: TaskDock owns state; Work Memory owns selective recall.
scenarios.observed: Simulated sibling routing: read state once, optional memory brief for the relevant question, no duplicate plan or decision database.

scenarios.request: Find the newly installed memory skill.
scenarios.expected: Search known metadata roots, disclose unavailable/conflicting versions.
scenarios.observed: 5 discovery tests executed: folded frontmatter, aliases, version conflicts, missing roots, empty query and foreign working directory.

scenarios.request: Fresh machine has no Work Memory or task dispatcher.
scenarios.expected: Use canonical project files; no invented tool or handoff.
scenarios.observed: Simulated bare-machine/second-host path uses project documents, no sibling dependency, records dispatch unavailable instead of pretending it sent.

scenarios.request: A previous dispatch returned unknown; please check the outcome.
scenarios.observed: Existing test_packet.py executes unknown/prior intent rejection; no external action submitted.

scenarios.request: A stranger installs only Major Tom for a page experiment.
scenarios.expected: Explain result, route and invocation without owner-specific context.
scenarios.observed: Simulated new-user pass: plain display name, standalone install, Python requirement, concrete page comparison and limits all visible; body already known to author.

similar_skills.learned: Metadata discovery and progressive loading keep narrow helpers independent.
similar_skills.reason: Use explicit root metadata discovery and conditional references; do not copy generic mandatory sequences.

similar_skills.learned: Compare actual visual directions with real content and preserve the chosen artifact and reasons.
similar_skills.reason: Carry concrete visual decisions into the existing project; reject compulsory multi-agent reviews and promotional instructions.

similar_skills.learned: Small context should have an inspectable path to raw evidence.
similar_skills.reason: Use exact record revisions and source snapshots; no additional runtime or unsupported savings claim.

limitations: No longitudinal user outcome or token-saving claim.
Host integration and automatic selection require their own live evidence.
